notes.title: 2025/9/4 Update
notes.content:
- BGM was degraded in the 7/15 update version, affected by the sound engine update of the game engine Pyxel Ver2.4.
- When personality changes occur due to negotiations with NPCs, etc., they can now be undone only once (normal mode only).
- The character that remains when the party is wiped out is changed to “the strongest member of the party” instead of “the first one” (Normal Mode only).

notes.title: 2025/07/15 Update
notes.content:
- Corrected the included pyxapp file to work correctly with pyxel v2.4 and above (Windows and Mac environments are not affected).
- Added navigation messages about changing jobs.

notes.title: 2025/06/26 Update
notes.content:
- Hard mode can now be selected even if the game has not been cleared once.
- The data deletion function in the Utility menu has been changed to a specification whereby data is deleted one at a time.
- Coyotes are no longer encountered in the first battle.

notes.title: 2025/4/18 Update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that caused the start of a turn to freeze under certain circumstances in battle scenes

notes.title: 2025/3/25 Update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that allowed certain recovery spells to be used on characters in a dead state.

notes.title: 2025/3/13 Update
notes.content: - Fixed a problem in ver. 20250311 and ver. 20250312 where the function to adjust the position of the A button on the controller did not work on the title screen.

notes.title: 2025/3/12 Update
notes.content:
- In version 20250312, the game sometimes froze when fighting an enemy with auto-healing. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
- The targeting function of auto attack has been improved so that the targets are not dispersed as much as possible.

notes.title: 2025/3/11 Update
notes.content:
- Priority of item use in auto-battles has been optimized
- Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from acting under certain conditions.

notes.title: 2025/3/3 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem in auto-battles where if a character in a battle can attack at long range, other characters who cannot attack at long range will defend themselves.
- Fixed a problem in which the formation was not restored when paralysis was cured with the use of RESTORATIVE.

notes.title: 2025/2/26 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a judgment error in auto-battles (sometimes giving priority to total attack items when normal attacks are clearly more advantageous).
- In the equipment screen, the values are now displayed correctly even when the attack power is over 100.

notes.title: 2025/2/13 update
notes.content:
- The default cursor now points to the target character when using items and spells.
- Auto-battle has been made slightly smarter.
- Fixed a bug in Hard Mode where resetting immediately after a battle would result in total annihilation.
- Fixed a bug that caused fairies to appear as NPCs on the 7th basement floor under certain circumstances, causing the game to freeze.

notes.title: 2024/2/8 Update
notes.content:
- Improved the visibility of the mini-map.
- The current number of items in your possession is now displayed when you buy or sell an item in a store or open a treasure chest.
- Items that are not in stock now change color when sell in the store.
- Improved behavior when pressing the left/right key in the item column.
- Default cursor for equipment now points to items that can be equipped.

notes.title: 2025/2/3 update
notes.content:
- Changed the UI when using the “Sell” command in the store (JST 20:55 Re-updated due to freeze under certain circumstances)
- Fixed a bug where certain events could be skipped.
- Fixed a bug that could cause NPC's completed quests to remain.

notes.title: 2025/1/29 update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that occurred under certain circumstances in the event on the 8th basement floor.
- Fixed some errors in the English version of the message.

notes.title: 2025/1/27 Update
notes.content:
- For items that have the effect of changing jobs, the conditions and effects are now known before use.
- Tweaked some of the layout of the status screen

notes.title: 2024/1/25 Update
notes.content:
[b]- Scenarios after the 7th basement floor have been added.[/b]
- Shopping at the store has been changed to be done by type (item, weapon, armor).
- The item warehouse display has been improved to show the quantity of the same item.
- Fixed a bug in which enemy poison breaths did not inflict poison.
- The current position display on the minimap has been improved so that it stands out a little more.

notes.title: 2024/12/30 update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that sometimes caused a freeze when pressing the left key in a store.

notes.title: 2024/12/29 update
notes.content:
This update does not affect game content.
As a countermeasure to the recent virus false positive detection problem, we have added a certificate issued by a certification authority to the startup file.

notes.title: 2024/12/26 update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in which the value of “Piety” after a job change was calculated based on “Vitality”.
- There was a glitch in the processing of auto equipment (cases where the equipment selected was inappropriate), which has been corrected.

notes.title: 2024/12/23 update
notes.content: - Fixed a problem in the hard mode where a penalty was also applied to reset after escape.

notes.title: 2024/12/22 update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go black when switching characters with the L/R button in the spell window of the menu screen when a deceased character was selected.

notes.title: 2024/12/21 Update
notes.content:
The December 6, 2024 update was temporarily downgraded due to a problem with virus detection by some security software, but the December 6 version was re-upgraded with countermeasures.

(Contents of the December 6 update)
- "BIRD EYE" can now select a destination and auto-move
- Added hard mode (once cleared, it will be selectable)
- Auto-save timing is now displayed

<<< Apology and request >>>

As one of the measures to prevent false virus detection, we have taken the measure to change the name of the startup file.
For this reason, there is a high possibility that the error “startup file not found” will occur after the update.

In this case,
- Restart the Steam client.
- Uninstall and reinstall the client.
Please do one of the following.
However, in the case of SteamDeck, save data may be lost when uninstalling, so please restart Steam.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you in advance for your patience.

notes.title: 2024/12/06 Update
notes.content:
- "BIRD EYE" can now select a destination and auto-move
- Added hard mode (once cleared, it will be selectable)
- Auto-save timing is now displayed

12/11 13:00(JST) Note: This version is currently being withdrawn due to a virus false positive detection problem. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 2024/11/26 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem in which gold doors were not being displayed correctly when the entire map was displayed.
- Cursor movement for “BIRD EYE” and “TELEPORT” has been sped up.

notes.title: 2024/11/25 Update
notes.content:
- The analog stick can now be used to control the game.
- The AC of the party can now be seen when using the “BLINK1” and “BLINK2” spells.
- Monster information can now be viewed in a single window using the “identify” command.
- The remaining HP of identified monsters is now displayed on the screen.

notes.title: Update 11/21/2024
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem in which data taken over from the trial version would be considered the trial version even in the production version.
- Added a mode that allows you to view the floor on a single screen when casting the “BIRD EYE” and “TELEPORT” spells.

notes.title: 2024/11/18 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a crash that could occur when using the “TELEPORT RING” during combat
- (English version only) The hints in the event message at the bottom level were not clear enough.

notes.title: 2024/11/18 Update
notes.content:
- The Enter key now functions as a decision button as well as the Z key.
- Improved performance for relatively low spec devices.
- Fixed a problem in which members who are dead or petrified are also subject to alignment changes.
- Fixed a problem in which messages were not always displayed correctly when obtaining items from NPCs
- Fixed the problem where the explored flag of a room would remain when returning to the castle town by returning

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: 10/30/2024 Update
notes.content:
- The process of auto-detecting the decision button has been improved. See the image below for details.
- Setting “Quick” in Config's “Moving Mode” now allows movement without a time lag in changing direction.
- Support messages have been added for some of the options in conversations with NPCs.
- Fixed a bug regarding counting the number of turns elapsed, in which the number of turns would be added by one if the player was defeated at the end of a turn.

notes.title: 10/25/2024 Re-update and apology
notes.content:
Ihave released the data transfer function in today's update on 10/25, but there were some problems that occurred when restoring the data, such as corruption of item catalogs and errors when purchasing items at the store.
This release is the corrected version. I apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 10/25/2024 Temporary withdrawal of update
notes.content: Due to a problem with the backup function, we have reverted to the 10/22 version. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 10/25/2024 Update
notes.content:
- Saved data can now be transferred between devices (title screen > Utility)
- Full-screen mode can now be set.
- Fixed a bug that prevented some NPCs from displaying anything when spoken to

notes.title: 10/22/2024 Update (modified version)
notes.content:
- [Important] Item warehouse has been added (conditions apply for opening).
- Ability-enhancing items can now be handled in the store
- Changed the conditions for using recovery equipment in auto-battles
- Other improvements to confusing notations

※ The version that was uploaded around 8:30 a.m. JST has been updated again due to a problem.

notes.title: Update 10/18/2024
notes.content:
- One-way passages are now visible when using “BIRDS EYE”.
- The character registration limit has been increased from 10 to 20
- A confirmation is now inserted when discarding items
- Tutorial and NPC messages have been slightly increased.

notes.title: 10/17/2024 Update (modified)
notes.content:
- Teleporter warp destination is now fixed
- Added automatic revival and healing messages when returning to the city.
- Fixed some spelling errors in English text.
- Fixed other minor bugs.

The updated version from a few hours ago had some problems, so we are uploading it again. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: 10/16/2024 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused two specific items to be consumed at the same time when used
- Added descriptions of the effects of consumable items
- Changed some colors of locked doors
- Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: 15/10/2024 Update.
notes.content:
- [Important] It is now possible to change the alignment in the Salvation Temple under certain conditions.
- [Important] The equipment of members separated in the bar is no longer removed.
- A command to return to the title from the menu screen has been added.
- Command descriptions during battle are now displayed.

notes.title: 14/10/2024 Update
notes.content:
- The problem of the screen going white on some Windows machines has been resolved.
- Certain items (consumables) that cannot be sold in the shop can now be sold.
- The attack power display on the status screen has been made more detailed.
- The Cancel button and cross key can now only be used to change direction.
- Fixed a bug where certain quests would reoccur after being completed.
- Fixed a bug with some messages.

notes.title: Environmental issues, frequently asked questions (updated 29/1/2025)
notes.content:
[h3]Detected as an "Unwanted App" by Windows Defender, Preventing the Game from Running[/h3]

(Updated on January 29, 2025, 10:22 AM)
This issue does not appear to have been triggered by an update to our game but rather by the Windows 11 24H2 update. We are currently investigating possible countermeasures. In the meantime, we have received reports that the issue can be circumvented by manually excluding the game’s executable file from Windows Defender’s detection list. We apologize for the inconvenience, and if you experience this issue, please try this workaround for the time being.


[h3]Gamepad Not Working[/h3]

(Updated on 2024/10/14 18:36)
Steam Input might be interfering, causing controls to behave inconsistently. Please try the following settings:

(Settings)
Right-click this product in the "Library" section of the Steam client and open "Properties."
In "Controller," select "Disable Steam Input."
*By default, "Use Default Settings" is selected.

[h3]Can I Transfer Save Data Between Devices?[/h3]

(Added on 2024/10/25 8:41)
From the title screen > Utility menu, back up on the source device and restore on the destination device.

- SteamDeck has been stabilised.
- In the case of a battle where escape is not possible, you can no longer select ‘Escape’.
- Some confusing messages have been revised.

- Added a message when a member leaves the group due to personality differences when returning to the castle town.
- Added some tutorial messages.
- Fixed typos in some texts.
- Fixed other minor bugs.
